summary: Iteration 6 — regression testing after the code-quality REFACTOR (backend _read_import/_classify_row/analyze_import/_parse_backup/_restore_photo/restore; importer _parse_row/_parse_sheet/parse_file; frontend WineBrowser split into BrowserToolbar/WineResults/ViewToggle/EmptyActions/useUrlFilters/useViewMode; WineFormDialog split into useWineForm hook + WineFormFields/WineFormSuggestions; PublicCartaPage filtering). Backend: ran full suite /app/backend/tests/{test_affinamento,test_carta_vini,test_import,test_public_carta}.py with pytest -n 0 → 67/67 PASS (14.66s). First run had 2 SETUP errors in TestSettings staff fixtures due to STALE lowercase test_staff@/test_pubstaff@ users left over in DB from a prior aborted iteration (random staff password regenerated each run → old password no longer valid, 400+401). Deleted the two leftover users via admin DELETE /api/users/<id>; rerun = 67/67 green. NO refactor regression. Validated via tests: import preview nuovo/presente/errore (comma prices, header-not-on-first-row, duplicate rows → 'Riga ripetuta nel file', missing nome → 'Nome mancante'), modes skip/update, template round-trip, _classify_row branches; restore invalid JSON → 400 'File di backup non valido', missing app marker → 400, staff → 403 (no real backup restore was triggered); public carta hides prezzo_acquisto & foto_path, hidden/no-foto/nonexistent → 404, toggle_off returns Italian 404, visibility hide/show round-trip, CSV+XLSX 'Visibile in carta digitale' column, import preview maps Visibile. Frontend: logged in as admin (Bordeaux-2026!), /vini: wine-count renders ('1 vino'), view-mode-list-button persists through reload (localStorage 'cdv-view'), view-mode-grid-button toggles back, search for 'ZZZNoMatchXYZ' triggers wines-empty-state with 'Nessun vino corrisponde alla ricerca' (hasActive branch of WineResults). WineFormDialog (useWineForm hook): empty submit → toast 'Nome e produttore sono obbligatori'; filled all fields (nome, produttore, regione Toscana, denominazione Chianti DOCG, tipologia Rosso, vitigno Sangiovese 100%, affinamento textarea with live char counter affinamento-char-count rendering 'N/500' exactly, annata 2019, formato default 0,75 l, gradazione 13,5% vol, temperatura 16-18 °C, visibile switch, note); 'abc' price → toast 'Inserisci prezzi validi (es. 24,50)'; comma prices 8,50 / 24,50 saved; success toast 'Vino aggiunto alla carta'; re-opened via Modifica → nome+affinamento preserved; note update saved → 'Scheda aggiornata'. Preferiti page confirms EmptyActions is hidden when fixed.preferito is true (no empty-add-wine-button / empty-import-button) and shows generic empty state 'Nessun preferito'. Public /carta-digitale in a fresh (unauth) browser context: public-chip-all + wine 'Amaranta' + public-search-input filter works. carta_pubblica_attiva verified true at end. Cleaned up: deleted TEST_Refactor_Wine via API, deleted the 2 stale test_* staff users.

minor.issue: Staff teardown matches `u['email'] == STAFF_EMAIL` case-sensitively, but backend stores emails lowercased. Teardown silently skips deletion → TEST_staff / TEST_pubstaff accumulate in DB across runs, and the next run's login fails with 401 because the user already exists with the previous random password (POST /users returns 400 user-exists but fixture tolerates that). Fix: compare `u['email'].lower() == STAFF_EMAIL.lower()` or delete by prefix.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Make staff teardown in test_carta_vini.py and test_public_carta.py case-insensitive so TEST_* users don't accumulate across runs; next tester must otherwise manually delete leftovers before running pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: useWineForm.validateWine returns `{ body: { ...form, prezzo_acquisto, prezzo_carta } }` where prezzo_* may be null OR a Number. OK for the API, but the hook does not guard against the empty-string edge case (parsePrice returns null → isBadPrice(null) is false → accepted) which is correct for optional prices — fine.

WineBrowser.useViewMode reads localStorage synchronously in useState initializer; good — no FOUC. Note the stored key 'cdv-view' is global across users on a shared device; acceptable for single-restaurant usage.

PublicCartaPage still mounted under the root AuthContext which calls /auth/me on load → emits 4 background 401 console errors on the public URL (already flagged in iter5, not addressed). Still a cosmetic/privacy nit for a customer-facing URL.

importer.parse_file / _parse_sheet refactor: parse_file dispatches by extension; good. _classify_row encapsulates 'Nome mancante' / 'Riga ripetuta nel file' / nuovo / presente — logic verified by tests. No duplication left in server.analyze_import.

server.restore now delegates to _parse_backup + _restore_photo; validation branches (400 invalid JSON, 400 no app marker, 403 staff) covered by tests. We intentionally did NOT exercise a successful restore (real customer data).
test_credentials: admin@cartadeivini.it / Bordeaux-2026! (works). No staff user used from UI; backend tests create+clean TEST_staff / TEST_pubstaff with random passwords.
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ prefixed data created and all cleaned up. Real customer wine 'Amaranta' (Tenuta Ulisse) untouched. carta_pubblica_attiva = true at end. Final DB state: 1 wine (Amaranta), 1 user (admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ALWAYS run `pytest -n 0` (xdist breaks shared class state). Before running backend tests, if a previous run was aborted, delete leftover users whose email starts with 'test_' via DELETE /api/users/<id> as admin — the staff teardown fixtures are case-sensitive and will miss them. useWineForm testids on form: wine-form-{nome|produttore|regione|denominazione|tipologia|vitigno|annata|formato|gradazione|temperatura_servizio|prezzo_acquisto|prezzo_carta|note|affinamento}-input, wine-form-visibile-switch, wine-form-submit-button, wine-form-cancel-button, wine-form-dialog, affinamento-char-count. WineBrowser testids: wine-count, sort-select, view-mode-{grid|list}-button (aria-pressed), add-wine-button, wines-empty-state, empty-add-wine-button, empty-import-button, wine-grid. Preferiti/Favorites page passes fixed.preferito=true so WineResults hides EmptyActions when empty.
rca of the issue: The 2 initial setup errors in test_public_carta::TestSettings were NOT caused by the refactor — they are caused by a long-standing bug in both test modules' staff teardowns: `if u['email'] == STAFF_EMAIL:` compares against the exact-case constant (e.g. 'TEST_pubstaff@...') while the backend lowercases emails on insert. On re-runs the user already exists but with an OLD random password → login 401 → fixture raises SETUP error. Mitigation (manual, done): DELETE /api/users/<id> for test_* users as admin before test run. Permanent fix: `u['email'].lower() == STAFF_EMAIL.lower()` in both fixtures.
